Run one read-only SQL query (SELECT, WITH or EXPLAIN) against the local database and print the rows.
The database is opened read-only; a second statement, PRAGMA and ATTACH are refused.
Main table: samples(metric, start_ts, end_ts, value, unit, tz_offset, source).

Usage:
  healthcli query <sql> [flags]

Examples:
  healthcli query "SELECT count(*) FROM samples"
  healthcli query "SELECT * FROM samples LIMIT 5" --json

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for query

Global Flags:
      --db string   SQLite database path (default: per-user data dir)
      --json        output JSON instead of human-readable text
